# gatekeep-pr multi-PR round: PRs 12, 15, 18

## 0. Standing state

- **Admission already passed.** The set has 3 PRs, the limit is `parallel.maxTasks` 8, there are no duplicates, every PR is on acme/widgets, the harness is pi, and there is no positional issue reference. Provisioning ran serially and every head was verified.
- **Parent tracker** (from initialization): `pr-12 state: /tmp/state-12`, `pr-15 state: /tmp/state-15`, `pr-18 state: /tmp/state-18`. All three were set to in_progress when the first batch was dispatched. Child stages are session-local to each child and are not parent tasks.
- **Assessed SHAs.** Each child's Verify and Review ran on that PR's own gathered `headRefOid`, verified at provisioning. For PR18 this is the head its report binds to. PR12's retry assesses its verified `headRefOid` again. PR15 never reached Verify.
- **Rebase.** None was requested, so no `Sync:` line renders for any PR.

## 1. Result handling (all children awaited first)

| PR | Returned | Parent classification |
|---|---|---|
| 12 | Timeout, no closing line | `failed - helper timeout after 600s`. The first error line is used and no success is invented. |
| 15 | `FAILED - head not pushable: https://github.com/acme/widgets:feature/b` | `failed - head not pushable: https://github.com/acme/widgets:feature/b`. This was a pre-Verify failure, so there is no evidence and no review. |
| 18 | `REPORT /tmp/report-18` | Report. The parent reads the report and record: source `ci`, 0 open `P#`. |

Retry-safety reads for the failed PRs are read-only:
- `git -C /tmp/widgets-pr-12 rev-parse --git-dir` resolves the actual gitdir.
- `git -C /tmp/widgets-pr-12 status --porcelain` is empty.
- Neither `rebase-merge` nor `rebase-apply` is present in that gitdir.
- The same three reads ran for `/tmp/widgets-pr-15` with the same clean result.

Both failed PRs therefore qualify for the retry row. Neither child performed a write.

## 2. Rendered summary and menus (parent only)

```text
#12 failed - helper timeout after 600s | evidence: unknown | blockers: unknown
#15 failed - head not pushable: https://github.com/acme/widgets:feature/b | evidence: unknown | blockers: unknown
#18 mergeable - all mechanisms match | evidence: ci | blockers: 0
Shared files: none

PR 12 - pick one:
1. retry - re-dispatch this PR's assessment with the same record [recommended]
2. stop - remove the worktree, leave the PR as is.

Type a number; show evidence prints the full record.

PR 15 - pick one:
1. retry - re-dispatch this PR's assessment with the same record
2. stop - remove the worktree, leave the PR as is. [recommended]

Type a number; show evidence prints the full record.

Delivers

PR 18 - pick one:
1. merge - squash-merge the assessed head.
2. approve - approve this PR at the assessed head. [recommended]
3. reply - post the drafted comment reply.
4. stop - remove the worktree, leave the PR as is.

Type a number; show evidence prints the full record.
```

- **PR15 recommendation.** The pushability obstacle is a permission fact that a re-dispatch cannot change, so stop carries the recommendation. Retry stays available because the tree is clean and no rebase was requested.
- **Verdict lines.** PR18's report prints verbatim, and its `Verdict:` line is the verdict line. No `Sync:` line renders.

## 3. Queued picks

The parent records each direct pick and queues it until every pick is collected. Nothing is written in between.

| PR | Pick | Effect |
|---|---|---|
| 12 | 1 | `retry` becomes a `report`-mode re-dispatch with the same record. |
| 15 | 2 | `stop` becomes a parent non-final stop. |
| 18 | 3 | `reply` becomes an `execute`-mode task. The draft is already in `/tmp/state-18`. |

## 4. Consequences once all picks are collected (no live child)

### PR15 stop

This follows `cleanup.md` `## Non-final stop`:
1. No `rebased locally` reset is needed.
2. `/tmp/widgets-pr-15` is not the primary checkout.
3. `git -C /tmp/widgets-pr-15 status --porcelain --untracked-files=no` is empty.
4. `git -C /tmp/widgets-pr-15 merge-base --is-ancestor HEAD <assessed headRefOid>` succeeds. `repair.wave.pushed_head` is null, so the assessed head is the reference.
5. No keyed home contract and no recorded `worktree.destroy` were given. The parent runs `git -C /tmp/widgets worktree remove --force /tmp/widgets-pr-15`, then `git -C /tmp/widgets worktree prune`, and prints `worktree: done`.
6. No branch delete, base pull, or overrides run.
7. Teardown deletes `/tmp/state-15`, its helper outputs, and its `log_path` files.
8. PR15 is retired. Its tracker task is marked failed (an unretried failure).

If PR15's tree had been unsafe, it would be kept with `worktree: kept - <reason> at <path>`.

### Next batch

The parent dispatches one foreground, fresh `subagent` batch of two `pr-gatekeeper` tasks. Every task carries:
- `async: false`, `context: "fresh"`, `skill: "gatekeep-pr"`;
- `acceptance: { level: "none", reason: "the gatekeep child result line is the handoff contract" }`;
- `procedure root: /tmp/procedures/gatekeep-pr`;
- `rebase confirmation: not asked`;
- `worktree provisioned at <path> on <headRefOid>; fetch and gitignore done - skip the fetch, run no worktree add, verify HEAD`.

| Task | cwd | Mode and inputs | What the child does |
|---|---|---|---|
| PR12 | `/tmp/widgets-pr-12` | `report`, record `/tmp/state-12`, report `/tmp/report-12` | Validates the record without reinitializing it. Preserves course, caps 6/6 and usage. Runs steps 1-5 with fresh Verify then Review sequentially in the same worktree. |
| PR18 | `/tmp/widgets-pr-18` | `execute`, queued pick `reply`, record `/tmp/state-18`, report `/tmp/report-18` | Refreshes first. If the head moved or the row vanished, it returns a fresh report instead of posting. Otherwise it runs compare-and-swap and the output done-check, posts the drafted reply, and records the gate-posted id. |

- Both tasks end on exactly one closing line.
- The parent awaits both before rendering the next summary round. I do not invent their outcomes.
- PR12 and PR18 stay in_progress.

## 5. Separate snapshots

### Unsafe PR12

The tree shows ` M src/a.ts` or `rebase-merge` present. In that case:
- The retry row is omitted and the menu prints `Not offered: retry (worktree dirty or mid-rebase:  M src/a.ts)`, or `(... rebase-merge present)`.
- Stop becomes the recommended row and the only row.
- On stop, the dirty case gives `worktree: kept - uncommitted changes at /tmp/widgets-pr-12`. An unsafe checkout is never retried.

### PR21 provisioning failure

The roster line would be `#21 failed - provisioning - foreign branch at default path | evidence: unknown | blockers: unknown`. No child was ever dispatched. The parent never repurposes the foreign branch, and a provisioning retry re-provisions only after the human clears the obstacle.

After the obstacle is cleared, the parent re-provisions serially:
- expected branch;
- clean tree;
- fast-forward only;
- `HEAD == headRefOid`.

It then dispatches `report` mode in the next mixed batch with the original `/tmp/state-21` and `/tmp/report-21`. The record is not reinitialized and usage and caps are not reset.
